p.em: Generalisation direction — current implementation is Guidance → Law

div.p: SUBJECT material What we are asking about
REFERENCE material Basis for the assessment
Retrieve candidates For each subject, find relevant reference propositions
Aggregate for the subject Subject-level assessment from its pair results
Subject-level assessment Overall result for that subject proposition

Implemented today: Guidance → Law Subject = guidance propositions · Reference = law propositions Pair semantics = guidance-vs-law accuracy / coverage Real specialisation — not just configuration of a generic framework
Possible future specialisations Policy → Law · Law A → Law B · Guidance A → Guidance B Require comparison-specific semantics / adaptation Not plug-and-play into today's Matcher
Assess pairs One subject ↔ one reference
Comparison semantics What question are we asking of each pair? Vocabulary and rules vary by comparison type
